notes.title: Trans Theft Horso - the spiritual sibling to Buy Hyacinths
notes.notes: [p]Can it really be three years to the day since [b]Buy Hyacinths[/b] was released, and Sheepy entered the world of games?[/p][p]No, the third anniversary is actually a fortnight from now. But why hesitate?![/p][p][/p][p]I (Ben, a person, they/them or what you will) made Buy Hyacinths, then scrutinized my soul for what to do next. The answer? A vibrant transgender western about pursuing the two great GGs: horses and gender gladness! [b]Trans Theft Horso[/b] just as vibrant and absurd as Buy Hyacinths, but bigger, westerner, and with rather more animated antics.[/p][p][/p][p]It's out now for Mac and PC. You can pet all the animals in it, too. Sniff sniff![/p][p][/p][p]I hope Trans Theft Horso will tickle your ivories and leave you with gender gladness.[/p][p][/p][p](Buy Hyacinths is by no means forgotten, of course. An update this autumn will finally bring a quest log to answer that perennial question: 'what am I meant to be doing?'.)[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes for September 3rd
notes.notes:
Hello! It's really fun writing patch notes - I've never done it for other projects, but for software it's a necessity. I've a full page of earlier patch noteses that no-one got to see, but today's update is public:

[list]
[*] Made it so you can click anywhere on paintings (or other wall decor) to get a response. (Previously, Sheepy could only nuzzle the wall directly beneath paintings, which was inconvenient and not intuitive for mouse-users)
[*] Bug-fix: if you stand to Jerk's right in the pub it will no longer cause the game to seize up.
[*] The pope now lets you skip part of the goose maze on your 8th attempt (no longer 12th)
[*] The lack-of-egg is now visible in the kitchenette in Act 3
[*] Sheepy no longer smiles when they're sad or angry.
[*] The creatures mentioned to be living in the corridor bin in Act 3 are now terrapins, because one of my first players was afraid of crabs. That's what I'd call a quality of life issue.
[/list]
